data.long_meaning: Ruthi is derived from the Hebrew name Ruth, meaning friend or companion. In the Old Testament book of Ruth, Ruth is a Moabite woman who shows unwavering loyalty and kindness to her mother-in-law Naomi. Her story is a powerful reminder of the importance of faithfulness and love in building strong relationships. The name Ruthi carries the meaning “Friendly Companion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ruthi usually hope their child will grow to embody friendly companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
